what I asked, and what you chose

I asked when apply focus should switch off. You chose: only while the editor is open — a preview. Close the editor and the whole calendar comes back, so there is never hidden state left behind.

how I would solve it

Three things. One: the branch list closes the moment you try to open a branch — the caret must expand without closing. Two: an apply focus button under Focus branch that hides everything on the calendar outside that branch. Three: every pop-up opens where you pressed and stays there — this is the same two-owners problem I found in the due-date picker, so I would fix it as a rule for all pop-ups, not one at a time.
